**Page:** The Malevich Award | Instytut Polski w Kijowie (https://instytutpolski.pl/kyiv/en/awards/the-malevich-award/)  
**Evidence**  
- Award establishment: *“The Kazimir Malevich Art Award was established in 2008 through the initiative of Jerzy Onuch, the director of the Polish Institute in Kiev, and by Wojciech Krukowski, the director of Ujazdwski Castle Centre for Contemporary Art, on the 130th anniversary of Kazimir Malevich”*  
- Award frequency: *“The prize is awarded every two years to outstanding contemporary Ukranian artists.”*  
- Former laureates list:  
  | Year | Artist |
  |------|---------|
  | 2008 | Alevtyna Kakhidze |
  | 2010 | Stas Volyazlovsky |
  | 2012 | Zhanna Kadyrowa |
  | 2014 | Lada Nakonechna |
  | 2016 | Nikita Kadan |
  | 2018 | Ivan Svitlychnyi |  
  (Quote: *“Former Laureates: Alevtyna Kakhidze (2008), Stas Volyazlovsky (2010), Zhanna Kadyrowa (2012), Lada Nakonechna (2014), Nikita Kadan (2016), Ivan Svitlychnyi (2018).”*)

**Coverage**  
The page provides a complete list of all Kazimir Malevich Art Award laureates from its inception in 2008 through the 2018 award cycle, inclusive. No other years appear in the list. The prize’s bi‑annual schedule and establishment year are also covered.

**Next links**

- The page itself (https://instytutpolski.pl/kyiv/en/awards/the-malevich-award/) is the source for the 2008‑2018 list.
